Guinness World Records · 2025 · Dhaka

The sound behind a world record.

Md Rizvi Rahman worked on the jingle music for Clear Men's "Pass Koro, Record Goro" campaign for Unilever Bangladesh — the campaign that set the Guinness World Records title for the most people in an online video chain passing a football: 8,239 people.

About · Biography

Built for the stage.
Shaped by the studio.

Md Rizvi Rahman (Rizvi Rahman Adit)

Bangladeshi Pianist | Keyboardist | Music Producer | Composer

Md Rizvi Rahman, professionally known as Rizvi Rahman Adit and also credited as Rizvi Adit, is a Bangladeshi pianist, keyboardist, music producer and composer. Born in Dhaka in 1986, he has spent more than two decades developing his career across live performance, music production, composition, recording and the wider creative industry in Bangladesh.

His musical journey has brought him into collaboration with established Bangladeshi artists, bands and performers. Throughout his career, he has performed with Tahsan and The Band, Ghuddy and Oyshee Express, while contributing as a session keyboardist to numerous musical productions and live performances.

One of his notable early career milestones came through his association with Ghuddy. As the band's keyboardist, he performed on the track "Attack", which achieved No. 1 Song of the Week recognition on the MTV chart in 2014.

His performance portfolio also includes appearances associated with Sunsilk Divas and collaborations with Recall Band, BlueJeans, ShuvoJatra, Minar and Mahtim Sakib. In 2024, he appeared as a guest music artist alongside Jal the Band, Vikings and Black.

Beyond the stage, Rizvi has established himself in music production and composition. He works at Sound Hacker, an audio production house based in Kakrail, Dhaka, where his professional roles include music producer, composer and keyboardist. His earlier professional experience also includes working as a music producer and composer at Colors FM 101.6.

His studio credits encompass a diverse range of musical projects, including co-composition and audio engineering for F Minor's "Rukhe Darai Nirbhoy" (2020), the rearrangement of "Praner Manush Moner Manush" (2021), piano performance for "Kajol Chokhe Valobasha" from the 2025 drama Emon Dine Tare Bola Jay, and the background score for the short film Ek Guccho Kadam (2025). His commercial music work includes composing jingle music for the Clear Men Guinness World Records campaign (2025). In 2026, his credits include music arrangement for Redoan Rony's feature film Domm.

Rizvi holds a master's degree in music production and has also shared his musical knowledge as a piano instructor at the Dhaka International Music Academy.

His professional experience extends beyond conventional music production. He has worked as a producer, composer and team manager on creative and social-impact projects associated with Plan International, ActionAid, One Billion Rising and Team Panda Event Management.

In recognition of his contributions to music, he was named Best Music Producer, Composer & Pianist at Anando Mela in 2025.

Combining instrumental musicianship, contemporary production techniques and collaborative creative experience, Rizvi Rahman Adit continues to contribute to Bangladesh's evolving music and entertainment industry.
